//go:build go1.27

// Package genericmethods supplies the Go 1.27 declarations used to establish
// the runtime expectations in the generic-method tests. It is stored as text
// because the Go 1.26 formatter rejects generic-method syntax even in a gated
// .go file. The Go 1.27-gated test type-checks this source explicitly.
package genericmethods

import "github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/concepts"

// MarkerOnly has a marker invisible to runtime reflection.
type MarkerOnly string

func (MarkerOnly) ConceptValue[T any]() string { panic("marker") }

// PointerMarker has a pointer marker invisible to runtime reflection.
type PointerMarker string

func (*PointerMarker) ConceptValue[T any]() string { panic("marker") }

// Full has ordinary codecs but only a generic marker.
type Full string

func (Full) ConceptValue[T any]() string  { panic("marker") }
func (Full) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }
func (Full) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }
func (*Full) UnmarshalText([]byte) error  { panic("codec") }
func (*Full) UnmarshalJSON([]byte) error  { panic("codec") }

// Ordinary has a runtime-visible marker and codecs.
type Ordinary string

func (Ordinary) ConceptValue() string         { panic("marker") }
func (Ordinary) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }
func (Ordinary) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }
func (*Ordinary) UnmarshalText([]byte) error  { panic("codec") }
func (*Ordinary) UnmarshalJSON([]byte) error  { panic("codec") }

// PromotedGeneric promotes only a generic marker.
type PromotedGeneric struct{ MarkerOnly }

// PromotedOrdinary promotes a runtime-visible marker.
type PromotedOrdinary struct{ Ordinary }

// ShadowedMarker's generic method shadows Ordinary's marker in go/types, but
// reflection still exposes Ordinary's promoted marker.
type ShadowedMarker struct{ Ordinary }

func (ShadowedMarker) ConceptValue[T any]() string { panic("marker") }

// AmbiguousMarker's markers conflict in go/types, but only the ordinary marker
// participates in runtime promotion.
type AmbiguousMarker struct {
	Ordinary
	MarkerOnly
}

// Nested returns a type with an invisible marker, not a nested concept.
type Nested string

func (Nested) ConceptValue() MarkerOnly { panic("marker") }

// PointerNested returns a pointer to a type with an invisible marker.
type PointerNested string

func (PointerNested) ConceptValue() *PointerMarker { panic("marker") }

// GenericMarshalText has an invisible text encoder.
type GenericMarshalText string

func (GenericMarshalText) ConceptValue() string                { panic("marker") }
func (GenericMarshalText) MarshalText[T any]() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }

// GenericMarshalJSON has an invisible JSON encoder.
type GenericMarshalJSON string

func (GenericMarshalJSON) ConceptValue() string                { panic("marker") }
func (GenericMarshalJSON) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)        { panic("codec") }
func (GenericMarshalJSON) MarshalJSON[T any]() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }

// GenericValueUnmarshalText has an invisible value decoder, not a value-unmarshaler.
type GenericValueUnmarshalText string

func (GenericValueUnmarshalText) ConceptValue() string              { panic("marker") }
func (GenericValueUnmarshalText) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)      { panic("codec") }
func (GenericValueUnmarshalText) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)      { panic("codec") }
func (GenericValueUnmarshalText) UnmarshalText[T any]([]byte) error { panic("codec") }

// GenericValueUnmarshalJSON has an invisible value JSON decoder.
type GenericValueUnmarshalJSON string

func (GenericValueUnmarshalJSON) ConceptValue() string              { panic("marker") }
func (GenericValueUnmarshalJSON) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)      { panic("codec") }
func (GenericValueUnmarshalJSON) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)      { panic("codec") }
func (*GenericValueUnmarshalJSON) UnmarshalText([]byte) error       { panic("codec") }
func (GenericValueUnmarshalJSON) UnmarshalJSON[T any]([]byte) error { panic("codec") }

// GenericPointerUnmarshalText has an invisible pointer text decoder.
type GenericPointerUnmarshalText string

func (GenericPointerUnmarshalText) ConceptValue() string               { panic("marker") }
func (GenericPointerUnmarshalText) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)       { panic("codec") }
func (GenericPointerUnmarshalText) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)       { panic("codec") }
func (*GenericPointerUnmarshalText) UnmarshalText[T any]([]byte) error { panic("codec") }

// GenericPointerUnmarshalJSON has an invisible pointer JSON decoder.
type GenericPointerUnmarshalJSON string

func (GenericPointerUnmarshalJSON) ConceptValue() string               { panic("marker") }
func (GenericPointerUnmarshalJSON) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)       { panic("codec") }
func (GenericPointerUnmarshalJSON) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)       { panic("codec") }
func (*GenericPointerUnmarshalJSON) UnmarshalText([]byte) error        { panic("codec") }
func (*GenericPointerUnmarshalJSON) UnmarshalJSON[T any]([]byte) error { panic("codec") }

// GenericDateEncoder does not supply runtime-visible calendar forwarding.
type GenericDateEncoder concepts.DateOnly

func (GenericDateEncoder) MarshalJSON[T any]() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }

// GenericTimeEncoder does not supply runtime-visible calendar forwarding.
type GenericTimeEncoder concepts.TimeOnly

func (GenericTimeEncoder) MarshalText[T any]() ([]byte, error) { panic("codec") }

// GenericDateMarker lacks both a visible marker and calendar forwarding.
type GenericDateMarker concepts.DateOnly

func (GenericDateMarker) ConceptValue[T any]() concepts.DateOnly { panic("marker") }

// GenericDateWithEncoder is codec-only after its generic marker is hidden.
type GenericDateWithEncoder concepts.DateOnly

func (GenericDateWithEncoder) ConceptValue[T any]() concepts.DateOnly { panic("marker") }
func (GenericDateWithEncoder) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)           { panic("codec") }
